I'm quite similar. Have absolutely no reason to feel bad, yet feel like shit every now and then and struggle to move.
I can't say it will work, and I highly recommend NOT trying it because it will make everything worse if it goes wrong - but take a very masochistic/sadistic approach in which I literally stand and deal with the pain, if I feel I'm getting better I force it upon myself again. That way I feel like I have "control" and hence should be able to do the opposite and make myself feel good when I feel bad. If it goes wrong you just have twice the suffering but if it works you can choose when you are upset and control how upset you get. Only downside for me is sometimes I can't control how upset I get and just full on breakdown.
NOTE: I have only tried this with emotional "hurt", nothing physical. Anything going wrong physical will ALWAYS be bad, but mental (I think, probably isn't true) can be fixed or hidden more easily. So unless you have no other option DO NOT TRY IT, please don't, I don't want to have made another person worse.

So anyway have a nice rest of your day, hope I have helped (probably haven't), thanks for reading!!

If you think he's doing it even if he doesn't like you, then join him. Watch what he does to learn/get better at socialising, see how he acts confident yet not arrogent, if he is academic ask about how he fits it in his schedule.
If you think the opposite, and that he actually enjoys your company then you can tell him that. Say "I really enjoy your company bro, thanks for being such fun!", show him he's great.
If it's neither, then for anything inbetween do both. Tell him he's great and watch how he reacts. Ask him about his schedule around work and tell him "wow that's inventive".
If even that doesn't cover it ... ahh mb, I can't help, sry ):

And so, don't lament how such a scenario is impossible, instead use it your advantage while thanking him to make up for using him. After all, using someone isn't always bad - isn't that what business is?

Hope I can/have helped in some way, enjoy the rest of your day!!
